title: Area-code-hunt shard B: 304, 307, 310
summary: Bounded dedicated area-code-hunt shard-B pass over the next three unresolved authoritative U.S. geographic NPAs after 301. Eight distinct organization identities were materialized with separate investigation targets, current-status controls, public communication endpoints where resolved, two evidence-backed outward organization relations, and area-code/locality relations. Historical Laramie Food Not Bombs remains explicitly unresolved rather than being called active.

data.research_question: Which public organizations matching or closely adjacent to the requested anarchist, anti-authoritarian, autonomous, Food Not Bombs, mutual-aid and organization-network seed families can be defensibly enumerated from shard-B area codes 304, 307 and 310?
data.method: Dedicated area-code-hunt-v1-expanded pass; current authoritative NANPA U.S. geographic-NPA gate; deterministic npa mod 3 sharding; literal code searches for anarchists, anarchist collective, anarchist black cross, Food Not Bombs and mutual aid plus Morgantown/Charleston, Laramie/Wyoming and Palms/Torrance/South Bay/Westside Los Angeles locality searches; first-party sites, public Linktree/Patreon/social surfaces, current media, Reddit discovery, historical directories and repository dedupe. Historical directories were discovery seeds only. X and Reddit official APIs were not used.
classification_rules: Only current authoritative U.S. geographic NPAs are eligible seeds.
Organizations retain their own public self-description and are not silently relabeled anarchist.
Historical directory/account continuity is not assumed without current corroboration.
Individual political affiliation and violent conduct are never inferred.
Name or handle similarity alone never merges organizations.
